Dialogs.Dialog: Kobayakawa
I want a doughnut.
Well, that's sudden. Want to stop and get some？
Doughnut cravings hit out of nowhere. And I don't want just any. I want the ones they sell out of a van.
A van... You mean like a food truck？
Yeah, everyone's been talking about it lately. Hearing about it made me want some.
Huh. Where can you buy them？
If I knew that, it wouldn't be an issue. Apparently it just pops up wherever.
(An elusive doughnut truck, huh...)
(Wait, is that the doughnut truck she mentioned？)
(All right, let's call ▲小早川＊▲ over.)
▲小早川＊▲! Look over there!
Kobayakawa
Oh, you're right!
That's the doughnut truck you were talking about the other day, right？
Nice, I'm impressed you remembered.
Of course I did.
Mmm, that's the smell I've been dreaming about. Let's go get some!
Kobayakawa
Don't you ever get a random craving for crepes？
Crepes, huh... Having them all the time might be a bit much, but they're a fun treat every now and then.
Right？ Plus, I like how they go from sweet desserts to savory ones with tuna and stuff.
Come to think of it, I heard a crepe truck has been coming around town lately.
Oh, I've heard about that too. But they're always changing spots, so you never know where they'll be.
Then let's look for it some time. When we find it, we'll get some together.
Really？ Yay. It's a promise, okay？
(Wait, is that the crepe truck she mentioned？)
(All right, let's call ▲小早川＊▲ over.)
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲。
There you are. Look at that truck over there.
Oh, so this is the famous crepe truck.
I happened to spot it. We said we'd get some together, remember？
Hehe, you actually remembered. ...It smells so good.
Let's go grab some right now.
Yeah! Now what kind should I get...
Kobayakawa
It's hot... Why is it so hot？ Hey, can I kick you？
What for...？
It might make me feel better. Blame Japan's gross, muggy weather!
Wouldn't eating some ice cream or something cool you down better？
True enough... Oh, come to think of it, a girl in my class said she found a new gelato place.
Oh yeah？ Want to go get some now？
It's a food truck, so just looking for it would wear us out...
I see. Well, I'll let you know if I spot it.
Thanks. Anyway, we still need to do something about this heat right now...
(Wait, is that the gelato truck everyone's talking about？)
(All right, let's call ▲小早川＊▲ over.)
▲小早川＊▲. Look, it's that gelato truck you mentioned the other day!
Kobayakawa
You really went and looked for it？
You bet.
Thanks for remembering what I said... Hehe.
Of course I did.
Come on, let's get some. What flavor should I get？
Kobayakawa
I want some really good roasted chestnuts.
Well, it is fall! Why so sudden, though？
The ones I had yesterday weren't very good... I still ate 'em all, though.
That's too bad... Oh, I did hear a rumor about a truck that sells really good ones.
Nice. Where is it？
Thing is, it doesn't have a set time or place. Makes it pretty hard to catch.
Hey, hearing that just makes me want them even more.
Hmm. Guess I'll keep an eye out for it, then...
(Wait, is that the roasted chestnut truck everyone's talking about？)
(Alright, I'll buy some and take them to ▲小早川＊▲.)
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲. What's up？
Just came to drop these off.
Wait...roasted chestnuts!? You went out of your way to buy them for me？
It wasn't any big deal.
Thanks. I'm happy I get to eat them and all, but...
Hm？
What really makes me happy is that you remembered and actually looked for them.
Kobayakawa
Roasted sweet potatoes, huh...
Huh？ Sweet potatoes？
Oh, yeah. I heard a rumored sweet potato vendor has been sighted around here lately.
"Sighted"？ What's the rumor about？
They're good, but you never know where they'll show up. They're like a legend.
A legend, huh...
Hey, if you find them, let me know too, okay？
Sure, I'll look around for them a bit.
(Oh, is that the sweet potato vendor we talked about？)
(Alright, I'll call ▲小早川＊▲ over.)
▲小早川＊▲! Over here!
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲。
Look, it's that sweet potato vendor we talked about.
It really is. Nice—nothing says winter like this, huh？
Yeah, sure.
Let's eat 'em while they're hot! Hope they're nice and sweet and fluffy... Hehe.
Now ● can't wait to try them, either.
If they're good, I'll buy some to take home, too.
Kobayakawa
Hey, hey, did you hear？
Understand what？
The story about how a bunch of students all saw a UFO at the same time.
Oh, now that you mention it, I think I heard about that.
Why doesn't one ever show up in front of me...？
Huh, you want to see one？
Not really, it's just... you'd want to get some proof, wouldn't you？
Proof, huh... Well, if I spot one, maybe I'll try taking a picture.
▲小早川＊▲！
Kobayakawa
What is it？ You're in such a hurry.
Anyway, take a look at this.
A photo？ ...Wait, is that a UFO？ You got a really clear shot of it.
Right？ Even I was surprised.
Wow, lucky you...
Haha, so you really did want to see one.
Well, yeah... Whatever, it's no big deal. Hehe.
Kobayakawa
Hey, um... Do you know about Towassie？
Towassie... I feel like I've heard of it, maybe.
It's a legendary giant creature that lives in Lake Towano.
Huh, sounds interesting.
So go look for Towassie and get a picture of it for me.
I mean, it sounds fun, but it's a lot of work. And I'm no good at waiting around forever for something.
Hmm, well, I'll keep an eye out when I can.
▲小早川＊▲! I got what you've been waiting for.
Kobayakawa
What I've been waiting for？ ...What is it？
Hey, did you already forget the Towassie search party？
Oh, right, that. Wait... If you got it, does that mean...
Yep, a photo! I managed to get a shot.
You really did... Is this real？ Did you take this？ What was it like？
Whoa, slow down. I'll answer all your questions.
Come on, quit dragging it out and spill it already. I've got tons of questions.
Kobayakawa
Midterms are coming up soon, huh...
Finals are coming up soon, huh...
Yeah, I agree.
Ugh... What a pain. Have you been studying？
Well... A decent amount, I guess.
Hmm, so you're getting ready... What kind of rank are you aiming for, then？
That's...
Aim for 1st in the grade
Aim for top 10 in the grade
Aim for top 100 in the grade
Kobayakawa
Sigh... It's almost time for midterms, huh...
Sigh... It's almost time for finals, huh...
You sound pretty bummed out.
Who even came up with a pain in the neck like exams？ I have zero motivation...
Maybe setting a goal would help get you motivated？
Okay then, what's your goal？
●Well...
Aim for 1st in the grade
Aim for top 10 in the grade
Aim for top 100 in the grade
Kobayakawa
Midterms are getting close...
Finals are getting close...
Seems that way.
'Seems that way'？ You act like it's someone else's problem. Are you gonna be okay？
Yeah... I should be fine.
Pretty confident, huh？ What's your goal, then？
My goal is...
Aim for 1st in the grade
Aim for top 10 in the grade
Aim for top 100 in the grade
Kobayakawa
Are you serious？
I mean, yeah...
Kobayakawa
You're not actually serious, right？
I mean, I am serious...
Kobayakawa
No way... Better not push yourself too hard, okay？
...Is it really that much of a stretch？
Kobayakawa
Talking pretty big, aren't we.
Well, every once in a while.
Kobayakawa
Since when were you good at telling jokes？
I wasn't trying to joke...
Kobayakawa
Wow! Aiming pretty high, aren't you？
You bet.
Kobayakawa
Huh... Sounds good to me. No point pushing it too far.
True.
Kobayakawa
Well, that seems like a reasonable enough goal.
Just playing it safe and steady.
Kobayakawa
Yeah, I'm sure you'll do fine.
Right？ Seems about right for me.
Kobayakawa
Anyway, now that you've got a goal... let's do our best.
Yeah.
Kobayakawa
No changing your goal now, okay？
I know. I'll do my best!
Kobayakawa
Hope you reach your goal. Let's both do our best.
Yeah!
And that's that.
Kobayakawa
So, how'd it go？
Finally over, huh.
Kobayakawa
Nice work. How do you think you did？
Phew... Done with the test.
Kobayakawa
Good work. Did it go okay？
Perfect!
Felt pretty good, actually.
Hmm... Hard to say.
Kobayakawa
Huh. Well, don't let your guard down tomorrow either.
Kobayakawa
Oh yeah？ Well, keep that energy up tomorrow too.
Kobayakawa
I see. Let's do our best again tomorrow.
Kobayakawa
Anyway, good work this week.
Kobayakawa
What a long week... Well, glad it's all over safely.
Kobayakawa
We both worked hard this week. Good job!
(Now then, how did I do on the exams...)
Whoa... I got 1st place!
Kobayakawa
No way... Seriously？
So things like this really do happen, huh...
That's my line. Anyway... congrats.
All right, I got 1st place!
Kobayakawa
Yeah, yeah, cut the jokes.
I'm serious, look.
No way... Um... congratulations.
Yes! I actually got first place!
Kobayakawa
Amazing! Congratulations!
Thanks. Feels like I'm dreaming.
Well, I believed in you all along, though... Hehe.
All right, I made the top ten!
Kobayakawa
Huh, not bad.
Well, this is what happens when I actually try a little.
Then next time you can try even harder and aim for first place.
Oh! I made it into the top ten.
Kobayakawa
Huh, so you can do it when you try. Congrats.
Well, yeah？
Don't let it go to your head. You're getting first place next time.
All right, top ten!
Kobayakawa
Congrats! That's great.
Haha, it's no big deal.
Then it's first place next time, right？ Good luck... Hehe.
Somehow I managed to make the top hundred.
Kobayakawa
Nice work. Good for you.
Yeah, that's a relief.
I need you to clear at least that much, you know. As my boyfriend.
Thank goodness... I made it into the top hundred.
Kobayakawa
Hmm, so you reached your goal. Congrats.
Thanks.
Well, a man's gotta keep his word, right？ Why not set the bar higher next time？
Phew... I made the top hundred.
Kobayakawa
I'm glad you reached your goal.
Yeah, what a relief.
Hehe... Now I feel relieved too.
Guess first place was impossible...
Kobayakawa
Well, you put in the effort... so it's fine.
Is that so？
Yeah. Working hard for first place is what really matters.
...Guess aiming for first was reckless.
Kobayakawa
What are you moping for？ Just try again next time.
I see...
That's right. There's always gonna be another test whether you like it or not.
Figured there was no way I'd get first...
Kobayakawa
That's too bad.
Yeah... Maybe I aimed too high.
No you didn't... Let's just try again next time. You'll do fine!
Too bad... Didn't make the top ten.
Kobayakawa
Feeling down？
Yeah...
I see... Well, I know how hard you worked for it.
Top ten... No luck, huh...
Kobayakawa
Cheer up. It's not like it's the end of the world.
Yeah.
Just make sure you get them back next time!
Man... I didn't make the top ten...
Kobayakawa
Too bad. Still, seeing you try so hard was pretty cool... maybe. Heh.
Got it, thanks.
So cheer up, and let's give it another shot next time.
Ugh... I didn't even make the top hundred.
Kobayakawa
Oh well, so much for reaching your goal.
And here I felt pretty confident about it...
That confidence is what makes you careless, you know.
Aw man... I couldn't even crack the top hundred.
Kobayakawa
Too bad for you. Well, you were probably close, right？
Yeah... Still frustrating, though.
If you go all out and aim for the top ten, making the top hundred might be a breeze.
Whoa... Seriously？ I'm not even in the top hundred...
Kobayakawa
Hmm... And after I was rooting for you, too.
Yeah... I just didn't put in enough effort. I'll admit it.
Well, don't let it get you down too much.
Kobayakawa
Anyway, exams are officially all over now!
Yeah, glad that's over with.
Kobayakawa
Come on, let's put all that behind us and go have some fun.
Yeah. We've gotta go on some dates, too.
Kobayakawa
And before we know it, summer break will finally be here.
Yeah. Let's switch gears and make a ton of memories.
Kobayakawa
Now that exams are over, it's already the end of the year. Winter break is right around the corner.
You're right. Let's make the most of it.
Kobayakawa
So, I heard this rumor...
A rumor？
Yeah. They call it 'The Ghost of Towano Castle.'
A ghost... Like a ghost story？
More like an urban legend, I guess.
Lately, people say you can hear strange groaning sounds at Towano Castle every night. Pretty cliche, I know, but still.
Huh... Well, a castle definitely has the right atmosphere for it.
So... wanna go check it out？
Wait... right now？
Yeah. It might still be a little early, but... we should at least get a feel for the atmosphere.
Hmm...
Then it's settled. Come on, let's go!
Now then... I wonder where around here it is...
It's a pretty big castle, after all. Just walking all the way around it is a lot of work...
...Now that we're actually here, it's starting to feel like a pain.
Oh, come on...
Well, I mean... ...Hm？
What's wrong？
Don't you hear it？ A moaning sound.
Huh...
Come on...
No way...
...Wanna head back？
...Fair point.
Alright, let's get going. Since my boyfriend's such a scaredy-cat.
Blaming it on ●, huh...
(Man, that's seriously creepy...)
Kobayakawa
Hey, I wonder what that thing was...
That thing？
You know, the 'Ghost of Towano Castle.'
...Oh, right, that...
Hey, let's go check it out again.
Wait, are you sure？
It's not scary if we know it's coming. Come on.
(...Well, why not...)
This is where we heard the voice last time, right？
...Fair point.
...Do you hear anything？
No, I don't hear a thing.
Aw, how boring.
Well, we might've imagined it. Or maybe it was some kind of animal.
Yeah, probably. Staying here is a waste of time anyway, so let's head back.
(The real truth was pretty silly anyway. Best to keep quiet and not let her down.)
Kobayakawa
Have you heard that rumor？
A rumor...？ I haven't heard anything in particular.
Then I'll tell you. It's the 'Legend of the Mansion Dracula.'
What's that, a game？
No way, it's a real rumor. People have been talking about it lately.
At the Western mansion in town, they say dark rituals are held every night... or maybe they aren't...
...That's a pretty vague rumor.
Well, it is a rumor. ...Want to go find out for sure？
Find out for sure？ How？
Like this... Let's go!
Wait, we're going right now？
Come on, don't be scared.
Hmm, it's definitely got the right atmosphere...
The rituals are at night, right？ Isn't it still a bit too early？
Making it work anyway is a hunter's job, right？
What's with the 'hunter' thing...？
Never mind that, get to work!
Yeah, yeah...
Hm？ Did you find something？
No, a sound... I can hear something...
Eh？
...You hear it too, right？
...Yeah, I hear it.
Well, now that we've cleared that up.
Let's head back.
Agreed. Come on, let's get moving.
(Is the rumor... actually true？)
Kobayakawa
By the way, I wonder if that rumor was actually true...
Which rumor...？
That one—'The Legend of Dracula's Mansion.'
Oh, right, that...
It's still bugging me. Can we go back again？
Well, sure, I guess...
Relax, you've got me with you.
(Hmm... Well, okay then...)
...Alright, come out whenever you're ready.
...Nothing's happening.
I wonder why. Is it the devil's day off？
Maybe. Or maybe we just misheard something.
Eh！？
Obviously it wasn't a real ritual, but I was still hoping for a little more.
That's usually how these things go in real life.
Well, it killed a little time, at least. Let's go.
(I could tell her the truth... but I'll keep quiet for now.)
Kobayakawa
Oh, did you see the news yesterday？ About that thing.
What thing？
'Bigfoot in the Mountains,' obviously.
Bigfoot？ Like, a cryptid？
Yeah, an unidentified animal. They say someone spotted tracks up in the mountains.
Huh... Just footprints？
Looks like it. They haven't found Bigfoot itself yet.
If they had, there'd be a much bigger fuss about it.
Between you and me, I hear there's a reward if you manage to find it.
Seriously？
What do you say？ Wanna try being a bounty hunter？
●？ Are you gonna help me too, ▲小早川＊▲？
...As if. That's way too much trouble, and there's no way it's actually real.
So why don't you go look for it to kill some time？
(Bigfoot, huh...)
Kobayakawa
That news turned out to be a real letdown...
Hm？ What are you talking about？
Oh, the 'Bigfoot in the Mountains' thing from before.
Turns out it was just somebody's prank.
Ah, that...
Even for a prank, I wish it had a little more style.
It wasn't hurting anyone, so they should've gone all out to make it entertaining.
Seems like plenty of people actually bought it, though.
Good grief. Still, I bet those people had fun with it anyway, right？
Yeah, maybe so...
Sigh... Isn't there anything else interesting going on...？
(Guess I'll keep what ● saw to myself...)
Kobayakawa
Want to hear a story I picked up？
Oh, what is it？
'The Ghost of the Gorge'... Ever heard of it？
A ghost story, huh... No, I haven't.
Apparently a lot of people are talking about it lately.
They say the ghost of a woman with lingering regrets haunts the Okutowano gorge...
Huh. If people are talking about it, someone must've seen her.
Seems like it. It's a cliché story, sure, but when it's this close to home, it's kind of exciting.
Is that how it works？
That's how it is. A minor local ghost beats a famous one far away.
Seriously？
(...A ghost, huh...)
Oh yeah, ▲小早川＊▲.
Kobayakawa
Hm？
You were talking about the 'Ghost of the Gorge' before, right？
Oh... Right, that was a thing.
What, tired of it already？
Well, nothing new came up. Why, did something happen？
Yeah, I actually got this email...
An email？
...See？
For a prank... it's pretty elaborate.
When I first got it, it really freaked me out.
...Hey, why did it get sent to you, anyway？
Uh... Beats me？
Hmm, wonder if anyone else got it. It's a local ghost, so it can't just be random spam...
(Well, at least she seems amused by it...)
Kobayakawa
Hey, remember when we went to the amusement park？
Hm？ Yeah.
I dropped something while we were there.
You did？ What was it？
My favorite cat keychain. I didn't notice at the time.
I see... Did you check with the park？
Nope.
Shouldn't you do that soon？ It's your favorite, right？
Yeah, I know, but there's this rumor...
Rumor？
Yeah. 'The Amusement Park Mascot Ghost.'
...Sounds like a pretty cute ghost.
Apparently it wanders the park at night picking up lost items.
So it's a nice ghost, then.
That's not all, though. They say if it picks up your stuff, you get cursed unless you take it back in person.
So that's why you're hesitating...
It's not that I'm scared of the curse... It'd just bug me, like I'm admitting defeat.
(An amusement park ghost, huh...？)
Kobayakawa
...Well, here we are.
Wait, how are we supposed to look？ We can't get inside.
Well... we just, you know, sneak our way in...
Hey now...
I'm kidding, obviously. If we just explain things, maybe they'll let us in.
I don't know about that...
Good thing they understood. Now we can look for it.
Yeah. Let's look for it before it gets too late.
No luck. I can't find it.
It's dark out, too... Should we give up for tonight？
Hmm... Huh？
What's wrong？
A mascot...
Eh！？
Mascot
H-Hey...
What are you two doing here at this hour？ The park closed a long time ago.
Oh, a cat keychain, right？ Yeah, I found that.
Really？ That's great, ▲小早川＊▲.
Yeah. Um, thank you very much.
Don't mention it. I was just doing rounds like this 'cause changing's a pain... Had no idea it started a rumor.
I don't wanna cause trouble, so I'll change first from now on. Well, get on home now.
...Haha, well, that was pretty anticlimactic.
Heh, says the guy who was scared at first.
Wasn't that you, ▲小早川＊▲？
No I wasn't.
Haha. Well, before it gets too late, let's head home.
Yeah, I'm kinda worn out.
(Well... that takes care of that, then.)
Kobayakawa
We made it here, sure... but can we even get in？
Who knows. We can't just walk in... Maybe there's a guard around. Let's take a look.
Looks like nobody's around. Should we give up for today？
...Yeah. Guess we have no choice.
Kobayakawa
Well... here we are.
No guarantee the ghost picked it up. Let's ask at the info desk if anyone turned it in.
Yeah.
Attendant
A cat keychain... No, nothing like that has been turned in. I'm very sorry.
That's okay. Thank you anyway.
No luck, huh... Guess we should give up for today.
Yeah...
